Command: Prove All Things; Hold Fast the Good
Summary: Paul's testing command: prove all things, hold fast that which is good, and abstain from all appearance of evil.
Commandment: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good. Abstain from all appearance of evil.
Application: Testing is commanded, not forbidden: claims — including prophetic ones — are weighed, the good kept, and even the appearance of evil avoided, because witness depends on it.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: to combine open examination with firm retention of what proves true.
